notes.title: New demo version - 0.93.28
notes.notes:
New demo version - 0.93.28
Problems with completing the initial quest have been fixed.
The interface, weapon setup, and surfing have been corrected.
The world map has been fixed and new regions and areas for exploration have been added.
An enemy and several types of weapons that you will find on the map have been added.
The version has been optimized for Steam Deck.
Gamepad support has been improved.
Game saving has been added, currently only to one slot.

The nearest update for the next version is scheduled for October 13th.
